title: Use Retention Policies to Avoid Unnecessary Database Growth

chapters.title: Default retention policies and job queue example
Configuring retention period and filtering records
Setting retention for failed and successful job queue entries

features.name: Retention Policies
features.description: Automated data retention and deletion feature that allows users to define policies for trimming activity logging and archiving tables to avoid unnecessary database growth.
caveats: Policies must be manually enabled by users
Policies can be configured with record-level filters to target specific subsets of data

features.name: Default Retention Policies
features.description: Business Central provides default retention policies that users can enable for common tables like job queue log entries.
caveats: Users must choose which policies to enable

features.name: Filtered Retention Policies
features.description: Retention policies can be configured with filters to apply different retention periods to different subsets of records, such as separating failed and successful job queue entries.
caveats: Requires manual configuration of filter criteria and retention periods per subset
